name: hyperlex-scan-elevated
description: Advisory LIVE_EMERGENCE_SCAN for risk tier ELEVATED. Atomic queries only — operator must register.
script: export HERMES_SKILL_DIR="${HERMES_SKILL_DIR:-$HOME/.hermes/skills/hyperlex}"; python3 "$HERMES_SKILL_DIR/scripts/hyperlex.py" scan --config "$HERMES_SKILL_DIR/examples/cron/scan-queries.json" --source combined --receipt --forecasts --append-log --json; python3 "$HERMES_SKILL_DIR/scripts/hyperlex.py" vector-seed --include-home --no-registry 2>/dev/null || true; python3 "$HERMES_SKILL_DIR/scripts/hyperlex.py" archive-export --include-home-receipts --history --snapshot-id "scan-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)" 2>/dev/null || true
notes: ADVISORY only — does not auto-register with Hermes cron.
Increase scan frequency; archive + reseed vectors after runs.
Generate fresh plans with: risk-schedule --tier ELEVATED --schedule-out examples/cron/
Scan never invents Brier; settle forecasts via settle / score-series.
